_comment: Retargeting map from an SO-101 leader arm to Spot's arm.
Copy this file, edit it, and pass it with --config.
Every key is optional: anything you leave out keeps its built-in default.
joint_map  -- position mode. Each leader joint drives one Spot joint.
sign flips the direction, gain scales leader degrees to Spot degrees.
Spot's el1 (forearm roll) has no leader counterpart and is held
at whatever it was when you engaged.
twist_map  -- velocity mode. Each leader joint drives one hand twist axis.
span_deg is the leader displacement that saturates that axis.
Linear axes are v_r / v_theta / v_z (normalized, cylindrical
about the shoulder); angular are v_rx / v_ry / v_rz (rad/s, hand frame).
gripper    -- low/high are the leader trigger range that maps to fully
closed / fully open. Set invert true if your trigger reads backwards.
leader_home / spot_home -- the correspondence pair used by --anchor home,
normally captured with both arms stowed by pressing H in the
teleop UI (with --save-home to write it here). Leader angles in
degrees; Spot angles in radians, ordered sh0 sh1 el0 el1 wr0 wr1.
Leave both null until captured -- they must be set together.
